column3: One Android Back press stays one Back
column4: On recent Android versions, a delayed duplicate Back event could close the game after returning from Changes. The registered system callback now owns Back input and discards its redundant legacy copy, without delaying normal navigation. Older Android and desktop navigation are preserved.

column3: Verify resource windows and Android navigation
column4: The full Android suite now checks current and older-save Strength Potion and Upgrade Scroll collection information. Display checks wait for the matching compiled APK instead of failing before it exists. Preserve failed and unpublished predecessor evidence, exact build numbering, original signing identity, saved data and compiled history.
